      "content": "# DSH × Blender

[简体中文](docs/zh/README.md)

DSH × Blender connects DeepSeek Harness to Blender so an agent can build, inspect, validate, and export 3D scenes in a real Blender session. The normal workflow is GUI-first: start Blender, connect the addon, and let the agent look, change, and verify. When no GUI is available, background headless jobs (`blender_run(kind="headless")`) still execute scripts and return rendered frames.

## Contents

- [Features](#features)
- [Quick start](#quick-start)
- [Tools](#tools)
- [Documentation](#documentation)
- [Troubleshooting](#troubleshooting)
- [Development](#development)
- [Support](#support)
- [License](#license)

## Features

- **GUI-first interactive modeling.** The agent works against the Blender session you are looking at. It can inspect the scene, run Python in a persistent kernel, take a viewport or custom-angle frame, and iterate one step at a time.
- **Headless jobs with visual feedback.** If Blender has no GUI, the agent submits a background headless job (`blender_run(kind="headless")`) and collects scripts, logs, and rendered frames from it. Live step-by-step interaction needs a GUI session; the job path exists so long or fresh-scene work still gets done.
- **Reference-image measurement.** Measure silhouettes, holes, symmetry, readable features, and scale from a reference image before modeling. If no scale is known, the tools return pixel units instead of inventing millimeters.
- **Parametric surfaces.** Build reproducible surface meshes from sections (loft), a profile swept along a rail, or a four-sided patch; run continuity, curvature, self-intersection, and thickness checks; then export GLB. The same spec yields the same `spec_hash` and vertices instead of hand-sculpted geometry.
- **Assembly audit and repair.** Validate an assembly manifest, classify clashes, hidden overlaps, contacts, gaps, floating parts, and contained parts, apply safe repairs, gate the result, and export GLB, FBX, or OBJ with a manifest and merge ledger.
- **Blockout and video-reference packs.** Build low-poly blockouts from declarative parts, render orthographic and perspective reference views, and produce a turntable MP4 for video models such as Seedance.
- **Visual acceptance and delivery gates.** Compare renders against references from the same camera, report defects with crops and measurements, run defect-injection evaluation, and block delivery when the gate is not pass.
- **Automation and long jobs.** `blender_run` submits render or headless work and returns a job id immediately; parameter searches and batch validation run inside the GUI session through `blender_op`. Neither occupies the GUI for the whole run.
- **Native selection.** Select objects or collections in Blender and send them into the current DSH draft.
- **Works in dsh-TUI too.** In dsh-TUI, a Blender selection is attached to your next message as a context chip; the footer shows the Blender channel state (connected / AI paused / rendering / jobs); `@` mentions scene objects, materials, and collections; and `/blender status|doctor|jobs` checks the channel without going through the model. Each part needs the matching dsh-TUI seam and stays off when the seam is missing.

## Quick start

**Before anything else: install the bundled addon first.** Use the addon shipped in this repository: **extension/dsh_blender_bridge.zip**. It must be your only Blender-side *agent bridge*: do not install or run `MCP for Blender`, `blender_mcp`, or any other addon that serves Blender over its own socket. The 3.1 addon dials the Gateway and opens no inbound port, but a legacy MCP bridge still listens on 127.0.0.1:9876; two Blender-side agent bridges confuse the host. Unrelated addons (modeling, materials, rendering, asset libraries) are fine and are neither checked nor blocked. Install and enable this addon in Blender before the other steps. If the installation below does not work, first check that this exact addon is installed, enabled, and connected.

### Requirements

- DSH (DeepSeek Harness) installed and working.
- Node.js 24.9 or newer is needed only for source builds; installing from npm uses the runtime bundled with DSH. Node.js 24.9 is the minimum supported version; CI runs on Node 24.
- Blender 4.2 LTS is the tested version. Blender 4.x may work; Blender 5.x is not yet validated. GUI mode requires the bundled addon (install it first); headless mode only needs the Blender executable.
- Addon compatibility: the bundled addon is the only required addon and the only supported agent bridge. Other addons do not conflict; an old `MCP for Blender` / `blender_mcp` is unsupported (it still listens on 127.0.0.1:9876) — disable it, no need to uninstall.
- Optional: a DSH source checkout when rebuilding the host side; otherwise the build links against this repository's installed dependencies.

### Option A: install from npm

This is the supported installation path. It does not require `git clone`, `npm ci`, or `npm run build`.

1. **Install the bundled addon first.** Download `dsh_blender_bridge.zip` from the [latest GitHub Release](https://github.com/sixtysevenlf/dsh-blender-plugin/releases/latest), then in Blender open `Edit > Preferences > Extensions > Install from Disk...`, select the zip, enable **DSH Blender Bridge**, open the `N` panel in the 3D view, and click **Connect**.

2. **Install the DSH plugin from npm.** Choose the path for your DSH host:

   - **DSH Web or DSH TUI:** install into the profile you actually run:

         dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-blender-plugin@3.1.0-alpha.1

     Then restart DSH in step 3.

   - **DSH Desktop:** open the Plugins page and install the bundle `dsh-blender-plugin@3.1.0-alpha.1`. DSH Desktop applies the bundle from the Plugins page and does not need a DSH restart.

3. **Restart DSH (DSH Web and DSH TUI only).** If you installed from the DSH Desktop Plugins page, skip this step.

4. **Verify the installation.** The only acceptance criterion for the GUI route is `doctor` returning `kind` equal to `ok`:

        curl -sS http://127.0.0.1:39877/doctor

   GUI route: `curl -sS http://127.0.0.1:39877/health` and `/doctor`; `doctor.kind` must be `ok`.

   Headless-only route (no addon): `blender_run(action="submit", kind="headless", script="print('ok')")` followed by `wait`/`collect` must return the job and its outputs.

The addon remains the only supported Blender-side agent bridge. Disable any other Blender-side agent bridge (a legacy MCP bridge still serves port 9876); ordinary modeling, material, rendering, and asset addons are unaffected.

    Read docs/AI-安装提示词.md first, follow it exactly,
    and finish with the acceptance check: doctor must return kind=ok for the

### Option C: build from source (developers)

1. **Install the bundled addon first.**

   Download **extension/dsh_blender_bridge.zip** from the extension/ folder of this repository. In Blender, open Edit > Preferences > Extensions > Install from Disk..., select that zip, enable DSH Blender Bridge, open the N panel in the 3D view, and click Connect. The addon dials the DSH Gateway at 127.0.0.1:39877 after Connect; it does not listen on a port. Replacing or upgrading the addon requires a Blender restart: there is no hot reload, and a 3.0.x addon keeps its old 9876 listener until Blender exits. If you previously installed the single-file `dsh_blender_bridge.py`, disable and remove it first: 3.1 installs only this Blender extension.

   Keep this addon as your only agent bridge. If `MCP for Blender` / `blender_mcp` (or any other Blender-side agent bridge) is enabled, turn it off — uninstalling is not required. Your other addons can stay. If the rest of the installation does not work, check this step first.

## Tools

The plugin exposes exactly 6 model-facing tools; all planning, audit, assembly, export, and evaluation operations live behind `blender_op` (34 families / 228 ops), so the surface stays small.

| Tool | What it gives you |
|---|---|
| blender_session | GUI session lifecycle and ownership: list/status/doctor, attach, claim/release, grant/revoke write scopes, pause state, presence, and `action=txn` snapshots/marks for rollback. Blender and the Gateway are host-managed. |
| blender_op | The capability catalog (`op="catalog"`, 34 families / 228 ops) and the execution surface for modeling, audit, assembly, delivery, and evaluation; also `action=loop|opt|preset`. Executing ops needs a ready GUI session. |
| blender_py | Runs Python in the attached GUI session with a persistent kernel; `see=true` returns a frame. GUI-only: there is no headless fallback. |
| blender_see | GUI capture only: `viewpoint=viewport|camera|custom`, `mode=frame|sequence`, fixed aspect/size tiers. Camera animation and batch renders go to `blender_run(kind="render")`. |
| blender_run | The only job entry point: `action=submit` with `kind=render|headless` returns a job id immediately; `status/wait/collect/cancel/list` manage it; `action=tune` covers render performance. |
| blender_inspect | Lists the addon's executable read-only commands and runs one with `command=` + `args=`; removed write commands return a `wrong_tool` hint. |

Old 3.0 tool names are no longer registered; the migration table is in [MIGRATIONS.md](MIGRATIONS.md) §0.3.

## Virtual display (virtual-gui)

On Windows and Linux the Gateway can launch an isolated Blender GUI for the agent. It defaults to `auto` on Windows after the V0 acceptance and is opt-in preview on Linux. Missing prerequisites never start silently: `blender_session start kind=virtual-gui` returns `stage=config` with the exact command, and `/blender doctor --fix` (or the add-on preferences button) installs only the same plan. One-click is limited to `xvfb` on Ubuntu 22.04/24.04 and Debian 12 through `pkexec`; VirtualGL must come from its official repository, GPU drivers are detected but never installed, and unsupported platforms get the manual command. See [configuration §5.7](docs/配置参考.md).

## Troubleshooting

| Symptom | What to do |
|---|---|
| doctor does not return kind equal to ok | Check that Blender is running and the addon is connected. For the GUI route this is the only valid acceptance check. |
| No GUI is available | Live interaction needs a GUI session. Submit background work with `blender_run(kind="headless")` and collect it with `action="wait"`/`collect`; rendered frames come from the job outputs. |
| Another session is writing to the same scene | Claim a write scope with `blender_session(action="grant", scopes=...)`, or attach a separate GUI session; parallel jobs are fine through `blender_run`. |
| An old MCP for Blender / blender_mcp addon is still enabled | Disable it (uninstalling is not required) and use the bundled DSH Blender Bridge addon; the 3.1 bridge dials the Gateway, but two Blender-side agent bridges still confuse the host; the legacy MCP bridge listens on 127.0.0.1:9876. |
| Images are generated but not attached | Update to the latest build; the Windows path fix is included. If it persists, open the returned path directly. |
| Followed the steps and it still does not work | Check the bundled addon first: only extension/dsh_blender_bridge.zip is supported, and it must be enabled and connected. |

//
// Section 6 exposes this to the Gateway and tests only; section 7 maps the same
// operations to blender_run without adding a second submission path.
import type { IncomingHttpHeaders } from 'node:http'
import type { CallerIdentity } from '../sessions/types.js'
import { JobQueue, QueueError } from './manager.js'

export interface QueuePayload extends Record<string, unknown> {
  op?: string
  id?: string
  timeout_ms?: number
  tail?: number
  kind?: string
  priority?: number
  state?: string
  owner?: string
}

export function callerFromHeaders(headers: IncomingHttpHeaders): CallerIdentity {
  const text = (name: string): string => {
    const value = headers[name]
    return Array.isArray(value) ? String(value[0] || '') : String(value || '')
  }
  const role = text('x-dsh-agent-role')
  return {
    hostId: text('x-dsh-host-id') || 'unknown-host',
    dshSessionId: text('x-dsh-session-id') || 'unknown-session',
    agentId: text('x-dsh-agent-id') || 'unknown-agent',
    ...(text('x-dsh-parent-agent-id') ? { parentAgentId: text('x-dsh-parent-agent-id') } : {}),
    ...(role === 'main' || role === 'subagent' ? { role } : {}),
  }
}

function failureResult(error: QueueError): Record<string, unknown> {
  return { ...error.failure, error: error.failure }
}

export class JobSurface {
  constructor(private readonly queue: JobQueue) {}

  async handle(caller: CallerIdentity, payload: QueuePayload): Promise<Record<string, unknown>> {
    const op = String(payload.op || 'list')
    try {
      if (op === 'submit') {
        const params = { ...payload }
        delete params.op
        const job = this.queue.submit(caller, params)
        return { ok: true, op, job }
      }
      if (op === 'status') {
        const job = this.queue.status(String(payload.id || ''))
        return job ? { ok: true, op, job } : { ok: false, op, code: 'queue_unknown_job' }
      }
      if (op === 'wait')
        return {
          ok: true,
          op,
          ...(await this.queue.wait(
            caller,
            String(payload.id || ''),
            Number(payload.timeout_ms) || 120000,
          )),
        }
      if (op === 'collect')
        return {
          ok: true,
          op,
          ...this.queue.collect(caller, String(payload.id || ''), Number(payload.tail) || 4000),
        }
      if (op === 'cancel')
        return { ok: true, op, ...this.queue.cancel(caller, String(payload.id || '')) }
      if (op === 'list')
        return {
          ok: true,
          op,
          jobs: this.queue.list({
            state: typeof payload.state === 'string' ? payload.state : undefined,
            kind: typeof payload.kind === 'string' ? payload.kind : undefined,
            owner: typeof payload.owner === 'string' ? payload.owner : undefined,
          }),
        }
      if (op === 'perf') return { ok: true, op, perf: this.queue.perf() }
      return {
        ok: false,
        op,
        code: 'queue_unknown_op',
        error: 'unknown queue op: ' + op,
        hint: 'use submit, status, wait, collect, cancel, list, or perf',
      }
    } catch (e) {
      if (e instanceof QueueError) return { op, ...failureResult(e) }
      return {
        ok: false,
        op,
        code: 'queue_handler_error',
        error: e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e),
      }
    }
  }
}

    if isinstance(node, ast.Subscript):
        sl = node.slice
        if type(sl).__name__ == "Index":      # Python < 3.9 的 ast.Index 包装
            sl = sl.value
        return _eval_node(node.value, env, label)[_eval_node(sl, env, label)]
    if isinstance(node, ast.Tuple):
        return tuple(_eval_node(e, env, label) for e in node.elts)
    if isinstance(node, ast.List):
        return [_eval_node(e, env, label) for e in node.elts]
    if isinstance(node, ast.Call):
        if node.keywords or any(isinstance(a, ast.Starred) for a in node.args):
            raise ValueError("%s 的函数调用不支持 *args / **kwargs" % label)
        if not isinstance(node.func, ast.Name) or node.func.id not in ALLOWED_FUNCS:
            raise ValueError("%s 只允许这些函数：%s" % (label, sorted(ALLOWED_FUNCS)))
        return env[node.func.id](*[_eval_node(a, env, label) for a in node.args])
    raise ValueError("%s 里有不允许的语法：%s" % (label, type(node).__name__))


def _eval_pass_if(expr, receipt, label="pass_if"):
    """受限表达式求值（`pass_if` 与 `degrade_if` 共用）。变量从回执顶层取；取不到 → 明确报缺哪个字段。"""
    tree = ast.parse(expr, mode="eval")
    _check_ast(tree, label)
    env = {"True": True, "False": False, "None": None}
    env.update(ALLOWED_FUNCS)
    missing = []
    for nm in _expr_names(expr):
        if nm in receipt:
            env[nm] = receipt[nm]
        elif nm in ("units", "tolerance_mm"):
            env[nm] = None
        else:
            missing.append(nm)
    if missing:
        raise ValueError("%s 引用了回执里没有的字段：%s（回执顶层字段：%s）"
                         % (label, missing, sorted(k for k in receipt if not str(k).startswith("_"))[:14]))
    # v1.0.2：不再用内置 eval —— 逐节点按白名单求值（语法白名单仍是上面的 _check_ast）
    return bool(_eval_node(tree.body, env, label))


def _aggregate(states):
    """整包三态（v3 收紧）：任一 fail/error ⇒ fail；否则任一 **degraded 或 skipped** ⇒ degraded；否则 pass。

    最小修（Lead 决议）：**任一门 skipped 或 degraded 都导致顶层 degraded，fail 优先** ——
    旧口径 `pass + skipped = pass` 被否决（"没量过干涉"不许拿绿，也不许为"健康默认 preset"降标准）。
    至少在有一门真 pass 且没有任何 fail/error/degraded/skipped 时才给 pass；
    一门都没有（空包）也一律 degraded —— "什么都没查"不给通过结论。
    """
    if any(s in ("fail", "error") for s in states):
        return "fail"
    if any(s in ("degraded", "skipped") for s in states):
        return "degraded"
    if not any(s == "pass" for s in states):
        return "degraded"
    return "pass"


_DOMAIN_DEGRADED_VERDICTS = ("unresolved",)     # 域内三态里的"证据不足"名：等同 degraded，不许读成通过


def _tri_of(d):
    """从一个 dict 里读三态（pass/fail/degraded）；读不出来给 None（调用方继续往下找）。"""
    if not isinstance(d, dict):
        return None
    if d.get("ok") is False or d.get("state") == "fail" or d.get("verdict") == "fail":
        return "fail"
    if d.get("ok") is None or d.get("state") == "degraded" or d.get("verdict") == "degraded":
        return "degraded"
    for v in (d.get("state"), d.get("verdict")):
        if v == "pass":
            return "pass"
    return None


def _status_of(receipt):
    """把一个门回执判成三态：pass / fail / degraded（回执不是对象 ⇒ error）。

    v0.9.6（复审修复）：**三态不总在顶层**。`audit_connectivity` 的顶层 `ok` 只表示"分析跑完了"，
    门结论在**嵌套 `gate`**（`gate.state` / `gate.verdict`）里 —— 顶层读不出三态时必须往嵌套里看，
    否则：① pass_if 写 `state` 就是"引用不存在的字段"（必 error）；② "未分析/未确认 ⇒ degraded"
    会因为顶层 `ok=true` 被读成 pass（假通过）。域内名 `unresolved`（干涉证据不足）等同 degraded。
    """
    if not isinstance(receipt, dict):
        return "error"
    st = _tri_of(receipt)
    if st:
        return st
    if receipt.get("verdict") in _DOMAIN_DEGRADED_VERDICTS:
        return "degraded"
    for key in ("gate", "connectivity"):
        sub = receipt.get(key)
        st = _tri_of(sub)
        if st:
            return st
        if isinstance(sub, dict) and sub.get("verdict") in _DOMAIN_DEGRADED_VERDICTS:
            return "degraded"
    return "pass"

def _run_boot(path):
    """执行 engine 拼好的启动前导（KERNEL_BOOTSTRAP + preload 模块源码）。

    为什么放这里：worker 原来只注入 K/bpy，preload 模块（audit/qc/runner…）完全不存在，
    于是热会话里 K.dsh_audit_api 等一律 AttributeError。engine 在 spawn 前把同一份前导写到
    --boot 指定的 .py；这里在 ready 之前 exec 一次。
    """
    global _boot_info
    if not path or not os.path.exists(str(path)):
        _boot_info = {"ok": True, "skipped": True}
        return _boot_info
    K = _kernel_bootstrap()
    out, err = io.StringIO(), io.StringIO()
    ok, errmsg, tb = True, None, None
    ns = {"K": K, "bpy": K.bpy, "math": K.math, "mathutils": K.mathutils,
          "Vector": K.mathutils.Vector, "__name__": "__main__", "__file__": str(path)}
    try:
        import contextlib
        src = open(str(path), "r", encoding="utf-8").read()
        with contextlib.redirect_stdout(out), contextlib.redirect_stderr(err):
            exec(compile(src, str(path), "exec"), ns)
    except Exception as e:
        ok = False
        errmsg = "%s: %s" % (type(e).__name__, e)
        tb = traceback.format_exc()
    _boot_info = {"ok": ok, "path": str(path), "stdout": out.getvalue()[-2000:],
                  "stderr": err.getvalue()[-2000:], "error": errmsg,
                  "traceback": (tb or "")[-2000:],
                  "kernel_modules": sorted([a for a in dir(K) if a.startswith("dsh_") and a.endswith("_api")])}
    return _boot_info

def _purge_modules(prefixes):

    import sys as _s, importlib as _i
    _i.invalidate_caches()
    pre = [str(p) for p in (prefixes or []) if str(p)]

    try:

    if lines:

        except Exception as e:

def _dv_normalize(parts, the, normalize):
    """bbox → normalize（归档铁律：scale/center/原 bbox 三件套必须留）；返回 (norm, center, err)。"""
    all_verts = []
    for p in parts:
        all_verts.extend(p["verts"])
    lo, hi = _dv_bbox(all_verts)
    size = [hi[i] - lo[i] for i in range(3)]
    center = [(lo[i] + hi[i]) * 0.5 for i in range(3)]
    longest = max(size) if size else 0.0
    norm = {"applied": False, "target_half_extent": the,
            "bbox_before_min": [_dv_r(v) for v in lo], "bbox_before_max": [_dv_r(v) for v in hi],
            "bbox_before_size": [_dv_r(v) for v in size], "center": [_dv_r(v) for v in center],
            "scale": 1.0, "center_offset": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0],
            "recover": "原始坐标 p_orig = p_out / scale + center（scale=1、center=0 即未归一化）"}
    if normalize:
        if not (longest > 0):
            return None, None, {"ok": False, "error": "零尺寸包围盒（几何塌成一点/共面到零）：归一化无从谈起",
                                "bbox_size": [_dv_r(v) for v in size]}
        scale = (2.0 * the) / longest
        center = [lo[i] + size[i] * 0.5 for i in range(3)]
        for p in parts:
            p["verts"] = [[(c[0] - center[0]) * scale, (c[1] - center[1]) * scale, (c[2] - center[2]) * scale]
                          for c in p["verts"]]
        lo2, hi2 = _dv_bbox([c for p in parts for c in p["verts"]])
        norm.update({"applied": True, "scale": _dv_r(scale, 9), "center": [_dv_r(v) for v in center],
                     "center_offset": [_dv_r(-v) for v in center],
                     "bbox_after_min": [_dv_r(v) for v in lo2], "bbox_after_max": [_dv_r(v) for v in hi2],
                     "bbox_after_size": [_dv_r(hi2[i] - lo2[i]) for i in range(3)],
                     "formula": "p_out = (p_orig - center) * scale",
                     "recover": "原始坐标 p_orig = p_out / scale + center（scale=%.9g）" % scale})
    else:
        norm.update({"bbox_after_min": norm["bbox_before_min"], "bbox_after_max": norm["bbox_before_max"],
                     "bbox_after_size": norm["bbox_before_size"],
                     "note": "normalize=False：文件里的尺度即原始场景尺度（scale=1、center=(0,0,0)）"})
    return norm, center, None

import { text } from '../../contracts/dynamic.js'

const RENDER_KEYS = [
  'file',
  'output',

  'engine',
  'format',
  'camera',

const HEADLESS_KEYS = [
  'script',
  'script_file',
  'file',
  'outdir',
  'timeout_ms',
  'engine',
  'preload',
  'factory_startup',
  'bootstrap',

  'args',
  'env',
  'shots',

]
const ACTIONS = ['submit', 'status', 'wait', 'collect', 'cancel', 'list', 'perf', 'tune', 'help']

function present(v: unknown): boolean {
  return v !== undefined && v !== null && String(v).trim() !== ''
}

function failureOf(body: Record<string, unknown>, action: string): unknown {
  const code = text(body.code) || 'backend_error'
  const stage = typeof body.stage === 'string' ? (body.stage as AvailabilityStage) : undefined
  if (code === 'queue_unknown_job')
    return toolError(
      'queue_unknown_job',
      'RUN ' + action + ' 失败 · 没有这个 jobId：' + text(body.root_cause || body.error || ''),
      '先 blender_run action=list 取现有 jobId',
      JSON.stringify(body.evidence || {}),
      'queue',
    )
  if (body.root_cause || body.fix)
    return toolError(
      code,
      'RUN ' + action + ' 失败 · ' + text(body.root_cause || body.error || 'unknown'),
      text(body.fix || '读日志修原因后重新 submit'),
      body.evidence ? JSON.stringify(body.evidence) : undefined,
      stage,
    )
  return toolError(
    'backend_error',
    'RUN ' + action + ' 失败 · ' + text(body.error || body.raw || 'unknown'),
    '先 blender_session action=status 看 Gateway/addon 状态',
    undefined,
    stage,
  )
}

async function postQueue(
  port: number,
  payload: Record<string, unknown>,
  timeoutMs: number,
): Promise<Record<string, unknown>> {
  try {
    return await backendPost(port, '/job', { surface: 'queue', ...payload }, timeoutMs)
  } catch (e: unknown) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      code: 'gateway_unreachable',
      stage: 'transport',
      root_cause: 'Gateway 不可达 · ' + text(e instanceof Error ? e.message : e),
      fix: BACKEND_HINT,
    }
  }
}

function submitPayload(args: Record<string, unknown>): Record<string, unknown> | string {
  const kind = text(args.kind).trim()
  if (kind !== 'render' && kind !== 'headless')
    return 'submit 需要 kind=render|headless（render=声明式最终渲染；headless=跑脚本）'
  const payload: Record<string, unknown> = { op: 'submit', kind }
  if (present(args.priority)) payload.priority = Number(args.priority)
  if (kind === 'render') {
    if (present(args.script) || present(args.script_file))
      return 'render 不接受 script/script_file：最终渲染是声明式入口；跑脚本请用 kind=headless 或 blender_py'
    for (const k of RENDER_KEYS) if (present(args[k])) payload[k] = args[k]
    return payload
  }
  if (!present(args.script) && !present(args.script_file) && !present(args.file))
    return 'headless 需要 script / script_file / file 之一'
  for (const k of HEADLESS_KEYS) if (present(args[k])) payload[k] = args[k]
  return payload
}

async function tune(port: number, args: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<unknown> {
  const op = text(args.op).trim() || 'status'
  const pargs = jsonPayload(args.args)
  let r: Record<string, unknown>
  try {
    r = await backendPost(
      port,
      '/perf',
      { op, args: Object.keys(pargs).length ? pargs : undefined },
      600000,
    )
  } catch (e: unknown) {
    return toolError('gateway_unreachable', 'RUN tune 失败 · ' + text(e), BACKEND_HINT)
  }
  if (!r || r.ok !== true)
    return toolError(
      'backend_error',
      'RUN tune ' + op + ' 失败 · ' + text(r.error || r.raw || 'unknown'),
      'op=status 看渲染设置；analyze 需要已打开的场景',
    )
  return { text: 'RUN tune ' + op + ' ' + JSON.stringify(r.result ?? r) }
}

export async function executeRun(port: number, args: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<unknown> {
  const action = text(args.action).trim() || (present(args.kind) ? 'submit' : 'list')
  if (action === 'help') return { text: runHelp() }
  if (!ACTIONS.includes(action))
    return toolError(
      'invalid_params',
      '未知 blender_run action：' + action,
      '可用：' + ACTIONS.join(' | '),
    )
  if (!(await ensureBackend(port)))
    return toolError(
      'gateway_unreachable',
      'Gateway 不可用（127.0.0.1:' + String(port) + '）',
      BACKEND_HINT,
    )
  if (action === 'tune') return tune(port, args)

  if (action === 'submit') {
    const built = submitPayload(args)
    if (typeof built === 'string')
      return toolError('invalid_params', built, 'action=help 查看 render/headless 参数')
    const body = await postQueue(port, built, 60000)
    if (body.ok !== true) return failureOf(body, action)
    return { text: formatSubmit(body.job as Record<string, unknown>) }
  }
  if (action === 'list') {
    const payload: Record<string, unknown> = { op: 'list' }
    for (const k of ['state', 'kind', 'owner']) if (present(args[k])) payload[k] = args[k]
    const body = await postQueue(port, payload, 60000)
    if (body.ok !== true) return failureOf(body, action)
    return {
      text: formatList(
        Array.isArray(body.jobs) ? (body.jobs as Array<Record<string, unknown>>) : [],
      ),
    }
  }
  if (action === 'perf') {
    const body = await postQueue(port, { op: 'perf' }, 60000)
    if (body.ok !== true) return failureOf(body, action)
    return { text: formatPerf((body.perf || {}) as Record<string, unknown>) }
  }
  if (!present(args.id))
    return toolError(
      'invalid_params',
      action + ' 需要 id（jobId）',
      '先 action=submit 或 action=list',
    )
  const id = text(args.id)
  if (action === 'status') {
    const body = await postQueue(port, { op: 'status', id }, 60000)
    if (body.ok !== true) return failureOf(body, action)
    return { text: formatJob(body.job as Record<string, unknown>).join(String.fromCharCode(10)) }
  }
  if (action === 'wait') {
    const timeoutMs = Number(args.timeout_ms) || 120000
    const budget = Math.min(600000, Math.max(1000, timeoutMs)) + 30000
    const body = await postQueue(port, { op: 'wait', id, timeout_ms: timeoutMs }, budget)
    if (body.ok !== true) return failureOf(body, action)
    return {
      text: formatWait(body.job as Record<string, unknown>, body.waitedMs, body.waitTimedOut),
    }
  }
  if (action === 'collect') {
    const body = await postQueue(
      port,
      { op: 'collect', id, tail: Number(args.tail) || 4000 },
      60000,
    )
    if (body.ok !== true) return failureOf(body, action)
    return { text: formatCollect(body.job as Record<string, unknown>) }
  }
  // cancel
  const body = await postQueue(port, { op: 'cancel', id }, 60000)
  if (body.ok !== true) return failureOf(body, action)
  return { text: formatCancel(body) }
}
